about: Review of the RunPod SDG matches (data/derived/sdg-skill-matches.json). Strong links = similarity at or above the provisional threshold and not rejected or marked uncertain here. Uncertain matches are shown with the possible links, never used for ranking or tags.
reviewedBy: Draft review by Claude on 21 Oct 2026 of the 73 matches at or above 0.60; team validation pending (data/derived/sdg-validation.csv).
thresholdReason: Provisional. Chosen by exploratory inspection of the matches on 21 Oct 2026 (data/derived/sdg-spotcheck.md), not a validated standard; to be confirmed by the team's validation, which will give the acceptance rate.
possibleReason: A display choice, not a validated boundary: matches from 0.55 to just under the threshold are shown as 'possible, not confirmed' because some are fair (carbon emissions reduction -> 13.3, calculate tax -> 17.1) and some are not. They never change rankings or tags. Below 0.55 nothing is shown.
